claims: Dozens of USPS retirees are facing months-long delays in receiving their retirement benefits.
There is a massive backlog at the Office of Personnel Management (OPM).
The massive backlog at the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is exacerbated by a shift to a new electronic system.
The massive backlog at the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is exacerbated by high retirement volume.
OPM works to process claims averaging over 79 days.
The USPS is temporarily suspending $400 million in monthly pension contributions to manage a severe cash crisis.
Federal retirement claims increased from 112,679 to over 121,000 between October 2025 and March 2026.
A shift from a paper-based to an electronic system has caused bottlenecks.
OPM works to offer interim pay.
The Postal Service is temporarily halting payments to the Federal Employees Retirement System (FERS) to conserve cash.
The Postal Service warned they could run out of funds within 12 months.
